newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE FEB 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE FEB 18.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Demonstration planned for Saturday against bill tightening controls on illegal immigration expected to draw wide left-wing participation.
-- Steelmaker Usinor Sacilor SA posts a 1.5 billion franc 1996 profit, down 66 percent from 1995 levels.
-- France Telecom launches pre-paid mobile phone card allowing callers to test service without subscribing.

-- French government expected to present latest state bailout plan for loss-making bank Credit Lyonnais including a recapitalisation estimated at up to 10 billion francs to EU commissioner Karel Van Miert this week.

EU authorities may ask the bank to shed some of its activities in exchange for approving the recapitalisation, but bank executives and the French government are expected to argue that Credit Lyonnais needs to keep its most profitable activities in order to become eligible for privatisation.
